canonical_project: Melita Primary Data Centre / Melita Madliena
notes: Melita describes its Madliena Primary Data Centre as Malta's only purpose-built data centre, Tier III-spec, with a fully fenced 10,000 m2 footprint. Locality is boundary-ambiguous for this batch: Naxxar includes part of Madliena, but the environmental-permit page gives the facility locality/address as Madliena, Swieqi (SWQ1013). Included under Naxxar as an edge-case lead, not a confirmed Naxxar council asset.
